funds.name: 1st fund (as UB Ventures, digital media & B2B/SaaS)

strategy.thesis: Invests in seed-to-Series-A digital startups (SaaS, AI, automation, marketplaces, media) under the theme of 'creating innovation in a depopulating society.' Spun out of the Uzabase group as UB Ventures, rebranded to FIRSTLIGHT Capital in 2024.

summary.en: FIRSTLIGHT Capital (formerly UB Ventures, a pure-investment arm spun out of Uzabase, founded Feb 2018, renamed Nov 2024) is a Tokyo-based independent VC investing seed-to-Series-A in SaaS, AI, automation, marketplaces and media across Japan, Asia and the US. Its 2024 second fund is around ¥10 billion. Notable B2B/SaaS bets include LayerX and Commune.
summary.local: ファーストライト・キャピタル(旧UB Ventures、2018年2月設立、2024年11月に現社名へ改称)は、東京拠点の独立系VC。「人口減少社会におけるイノベーション創出」をテーマに、SaaS・AI・オートメーション・マーケットプレイス・メディアなどデジタル領域のシード〜シリーズA企業へ投資。2024年に約100億円規模の2号ファンドを組成。

strategy.thesis: Independent seed VC that leads and provides hands-on support to startups founded by ex-large-corporate entrepreneurs. Three theme areas: 'AI/DX' (vertical SaaS/B2B), 'GX/ClimateTech', and 'Japan Culture to Global', with particular strength in AI/DX and real-world heavy industries. Excludes biotech.

summary.en: HAKOBUNE is a Tokyo-based (Nihonbashi, Chuo-ku) independent seed VC founded May 2022 by Yusuke Kurishima and Masahiro Kimura, with a first fund of up to ¥2 billion. It leads pre-seed/seed rounds (¥10M–30M pre-seed; ¥30M–50M seed) in vertical SaaS/B2B, AI/DX, GX/ClimateTech and Japan-culture-to-global startups, providing hands-on support; biotech excluded.
summary.local: HAKOBUNE(ハコブネ)は、2022年5月設立・東京日本橋拠点の独立系シードVC。代表は栗島祐介・木村正博。1号ファンド規模は最大20億円。プレシード(1,000〜3,000万円)・シード(3,000〜5,000万円)を中心に、垂直SaaS/B2B、AI/DX、GX/ClimateTech、Japan Culture to Global領域へリード投資しハンズオン支援を行う(バイオは対象外)。

check_size.raw: ¥50M–500M initial; up to ¥1B–2B per startup with follow-on

strategy.thesis: X-Tech VC investing where internet/technology fuses with real-world industries. Core 'BIG4' focus on Smart Infrastructure (incl. ClimateTech), FinTech, Healthcare and AI, plus DeepTech across industries; also manages multiple enterprise CVC funds via Spiral Innovation Partners.

summary.en: Spiral Capital is a Tokyo-based VC founded in 2016 (independent since 2017) investing in X-Tech (internet x real-world industry). Its 'BIG4' focus is Smart Infrastructure (incl. ClimateTech), FinTech, Healthcare and AI plus cross-industry DeepTech. It runs three Japan Funds (¥7B 2016, ¥12B 2019, ¥15B target 2024) with ¥50M–500M initial checks, and also manages multiple enterprise CVC funds through Spiral Innovation Partners.
summary.local: Spiral Capitalは2016年設立(2017年独立)・東京拠点のVC。インターネット/テクノロジーと実産業が融合するX-Tech領域に投資。スマートインフラ(ClimateTech含む)・FinTech・ヘルスケア・AIを中核領域とし、横断的にDeepTechにも投資。Japan Fund I(70億円/2016)、II(120億円/2019)、III(150億円目標/2024)を運用し、初回投資は5,000万〜5億円。Spiral Innovation Partnersを通じ複数の事業会社CVCファンドも運営。

name.local: Headline Asia（旧インフィニティ・ベンチャーズ）

strategy.thesis: Pan-Asia technology VC (HQ Tokyo, teams in Taipei and Beijing), part of the global Headline network. Invests early-to-growth across fintech, e-commerce, software/SaaS, developer tools, open-source, digital health, media and Web3 in Japan, Southeast Asia and India.

summary.en: Headline Asia (formerly Infinity Ventures / IVP), founded 2008 by Akio Tanaka and Hirofumi Ono and HQ'd in Tokyo with offices in Taipei and Beijing, is the Asia arm of the global Headline VC network. It invests early-to-growth across fintech, e-commerce, software/SaaS, developer tools, open-source, digital health and Web3 in Japan, SEA and India. It manages ~¥270B cumulative across four funds; Fund V is ¥22B (~$145M), its largest. Exits include freee and WealthNavi (IPOs).
summary.local: Headline Asia(旧インフィニティ・ベンチャーズ/IVP)は、2008年に田中章雄・小野裕史が設立、東京本社・台北/北京拠点のアジア系テックVCで、グローバルHeadlineネットワークのアジア部門。日本・東南アジア・インドを対象に、フィンテック・EC・ソフトウェア/SaaS・開発者ツール・オープンソース・デジタルヘルス・Web3へアーリー〜グロースで投資。4ファンド累計約2,700億円を運用し、5号ファンドは過去最大の220億円(約1.45億ドル)。freee・WealthNaviなどのIPO実績を持つ。
